text:
Nina (Partnerships): FYI GlacierTech's EU procurement blocked PO GC-24-1099 in the marketplace. They say the billing entity VAT/EORI doesn't match customs docs, so freight is on hold.
Carlos (Deal Desk): Portal error?
vendor-bot: marketplace-api: PO validation failed -> code 409_tax_mismatch / missing_eori
Ivy (Marketplace): Portal requires exact VAT and EORI string match against vendor record. Looks like our EU entity isn't registered there.
Nina (Partnerships): PO shows billing 'Redwood Inference Inc.' but Glacier needs invoices from 'Redwood EU SARL' with EORI FR123456789 for customs clearance.
Ben (Finance): We have Redwood EU SARL but it's not set up in the marketplace. Onboarding normally takes 48-72 hours.
Carlos (Deal Desk): Glacier says shipments will be returned if not cleared. Any fast workaround?
Omar (Legal): Two quick options: A) provide a notarized attestation + buyer email accepting invoices to Redwood EU SARL for this PO; B) manual customs broker letter. Option A preferred by procurement.
Nina (Partnerships): Buyer asked for an attestation line: "GlacierProcurement accepts invoices issued to 'Redwood EU SARL (EORI: FR123456789)' for PO GC-24-1099." Can someone draft and get signature?
Ben (Finance): I'll open FIN ticket FIN-9044 and upload VAT cert + preliminary EORI doc. ETA 6 hours to notarize.
Omar (Legal): Drafted attestation and posted link. If buyer emails that one-liner, Legal can convert into an addendum.
Ivy (Marketplace): When docs are ready I can toggle vendor record to accept EU entity for this PO and re-run ingestion. I'll need the buyer email and FIN ticket ID.
Carlos (Deal Desk): I'll ask buyer for the one-liner and a scanned procurement stamp. Pinging them now.
vendor-bot: marketplace-api: pending admin action -> awaiting docs FIN-9044
Ben (Finance): Uploaded notarized EORI and VAT cert to FIN-9044.
Nina (Partnerships): Buyer emailed the exact acceptance sentence and attached procurement stamp. Forwarding in thread.
Omar (Legal): Acceptance wording OK. I'll attach signed addendum referencing GC-24-1099.
Ivy (Marketplace): Applying vendor record change and re-running ingestion...
vendor-bot: marketplace-api: PO ingestion re-run -> success. GC-24-1099 accepted. Customs released.
Nina (Partnerships): Shipping cleared. Post-mortem action: add an onboarding checklist item for EU entity + EORI for hardware shipments.
Carlos (Deal Desk): Adding to checklist and tagging marketplace pre-flight.
Ben (Finance): FIN-9044 will include ledger mapping for Redwood EU SARL to avoid reconciliation issues.
Omar (Legal): I'll make a short playbook for attestation + buyer acceptance template.
Ivy (Marketplace): Also adding schema flag to accept per-PO entity overrides.
Nina (Partnerships): Thanks team ":tada:" Closing thread once playbook and checklist items are live.
